question: Can a transparent direction-invariant finite token-difference gate selectively execute the sufficient A1/A2 entry12 coordinates?

prior_art.known_lessons: Gold routing composes; native state is information-impossible; raw linear deltas fail reversed direction; Gram features restore targets but leak three controls; the preregistered Gram kill rule forbids a threshold tweak.
prior_art.novelty: Use the exact unordered aligned token-difference signature as a small transparent source/background gate, separating routing from the causal state coordinates.

frozen_design.signature: For equal-length aligned base/source token rows, collect every unequal token pair through the semantic position, sort each pair internally to remove direction, and preserve positional order. Empty or unknown signatures default off.
frozen_design.fit: On opposite parity, map signatures observed exclusively on A1 to A1 and exclusively on A2 to A2; any collision, P/C overlap, or ambiguity invalidates. No held label is consulted.
frozen_design.causal_program: On held parity, choose the matching A1/A2 proposed entry12 delta or zero, project through the fixed construction union, and install at entry12.
frozen_design.controls: Report signature dictionaries/collisions, held confusion, learned/gold/ungated causal programs, full/zero replays, and P/C KL/flips.

predictions.pred_a_authority_alignment_scope_replay_: Hashes, equal-length alignment, collision-free train signatures, crossfit, replays, finite metrics, and literal price pass.
predictions.pred_b_token_router_identifies_held_bran: Held macro accuracy is 1.0 in both parities with zero P/C rows routed to target.
predictions.pred_c_routed_union_preserves_both_targe: The routed program projects >=.75 with direction fraction >=.875 on both targets in both parities.
predictions.pred_d_routed_union_is_control_selective: The program has zero P/C flips and mean KL <=.02 in both parities.
predictions.pred_e_router_matches_gold_union: Learned and gold routed logits match within 1e-4 in both parities.

decision: A failure invalidates. B/C/D/E creates a selective v15 finite-program screen and licenses unseen-cue OOD plus weight translation of the two state coordinates. Failure closes explicit signature routing. No v15 pass alone is identification because the cue pairs recur across lexical groups.
